# Vetta 0.6.22
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-25 -->

## English

### New

- Scheduled tasks can send their results to a Claw chat, no webhook needed. Your first private chat becomes the receiving chat; send /notify in any chat to move it there. Long results are no longer cut off, and failures show in run history.
- Claw settings show which chat receives automation results, and you can clear it to pick a new one without disconnecting the channel.

### Improvements

- Hovering your own message now shows edit, fork and copy to the left of the bubble, vertically centered, instead of on an extra row below, so messages sit closer together.
- Mermaid diagrams display at their real size without a height cap, so wide architecture charts fill the content area; zoom, copy and save are now small icons in the code block header.
- The agent no longer carries a built-in HTML-to-PDF tool in every session, keeping its tool list shorter.

### Fixes

- In dark themes, Mermaid diagrams use the light palette on a soft gray canvas instead of hard-to-read dark colors, and copied or saved diagrams have a white background.

## 中文

### 新增

- 定时任务可以把结果发到 Claw 对话，无需另配 Webhook：第一个私聊自动成为接收对话，在任意对话发 /notify 可改到那里；长结果不再被截断，发送失败可在执行历史查看。
- Claw 设置页显示自动化结果的接收对话，可清除后重新指定，无需断开整个渠道。

### 改进

- 悬停自己发的消息时，编辑、分叉、复制按钮出现在气泡左侧并垂直居中，不再占用气泡下方一行，消息排得更紧凑。
- Mermaid 图按实际尺寸完整显示、不再限高，宽的架构图铺满内容区；放大、复制、另存改为代码块顶栏的小图标。
- Agent 不再在每个会话里常驻内置的 HTML 转 PDF 工具，工具列表更精简。

### 修复

- 深色主题下 Mermaid 图改用浅色配色并放在柔和的浅灰底上，不再难以辨认；复制和另存的图带白色背景。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.21...v0.6.22
